bias.zh: 偏空 · 盘中创 52 周新低

read.en: MP Materials fell 2.4% on Oct 22 to $38.56, trading between $37.57 and $38.96. It is below all its falling averages: 5-day ($39.25), 10-day ($40.97), 30-day ($45.79), 100-day ($51.18) and 200-day ($55.93). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($44.23), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月22日下跌 2.4%，收于 $38.56，盘中区间 $37.57–38.96。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$39.25）、10 日（$40.97）、30 日（$45.79）、100 日（$51.18）和 200 日均线（$55.93）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$44.23），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The low set a new 52-week low at $37.57, under the $37.81 Jul 29 low, but the close held above it; the close slipped under the $38.6 Oct 15 low, now resistance. Resistance is $38.6–39.3 (Oct 15 low, 5-day), then $40–41 (10-day) and $44.2–44.5 (SAR, Oct 1 low). Support is $37.6–37.8, then $35. A close below $37.6 would open $35.
read.zh: 盘中低点 $37.57 创 52 周新低，低于 7月29日低点 $37.81，但收盘守在其上方；收盘跌破 10月15日低点 $38.6，该位置转为阻力。阻力为 $38.6–39.3（10月15日低点、5 日均线），其次 $40–41（10 日均线）和 $44.2–44.5（SAR、10月1日低点）。支撑为 $37.6–37.8，其次 $35。若收盘跌破 $37.6，将打开 $35。
